blocks.text: Damped oscillation mein rukawat wali forces ki wajah se oscillator der tak apni natural frequency par nahi jhool sakta aur amplitude aahista aahista kam hota jata hai. Lekin agar bahar se ek periodic (baar baar barabar waqfe se lagne wali) force lagayi jaye to amplitude constant rakha ja sakta hai; is force ko driving force kehte hain. Jab jhoolte jism par periodic driving force lagti hai to us oscillation ko forced oscillation aur us force ki frequency ko driving frequency kehte hain. Engine chalne se gari ka thartharana forced vibration ki misal hai. Forced oscillation ka amplitude is baat par munhasir hai ke driving frequency aur jism ki natural frequency ka aapas mein kya talluq hai.

Agar driving force ki frequency jism ki natural frequency ke barabar ho to vibration ka amplitude bohat zyada barh jata hai. Is ko resonance kehte hain. Kitab ke mutabiq resonance tab bhi hoti hai jab lagayi gayi force ki frequency natural frequency ka poora guna (integral multiple) ho. Agar natural frequency f₁ ho to resonance in frequencies par hogi:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Simple pendulum ya spring par mass ki sirf ek natural frequency hoti hai, is liye woh sirf usi frequency par zor se jhoolte hain. Khinchi hui taarein (strings) aur hawa ke columns (pipes) ki kai natural frequencies hoti hain, f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁ waghera, aur woh har ek par resonate kar sakte hain. Guna (multiple) wali baat zyada tar aise systems par laagu hoti hai.
Resonance dikhane ke liye ek asaan tajurba (experiment): pendulums ke do jore hain, A aur B jin ki lambai ℓ₁ hai, aur C aur D jin ki lambai ℓ₂ hai. Sab ek horizontal rod se latke hain (Fig. 14.17).
Ab ek aur pendulum P lagate hain jis ki lambai badli ja sakti hai: ya ℓ₁ ya ℓ₂. Pehle P ki lambai ℓ₁ rakhein.

blocks.alt: Do stands ke darmiyan aik ufqi rod se paanch pendulum latke hain: P (hara), A, C, B aur D. P, A aur B ki lambai aik jaisi l1 hai; C aur D (surkh) chhote hain, lambai l2.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.17: Mukhtalif lambai ke paanch pendulums ka set (kitab ki Figure 14.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Jab P ko jhulaya jaye to us ki thartharahat rod ke zariye baqi pendulums tak pohanchti hai. A aur B ko rod se driving force milti hai; un ki lambai, natural frequency aur natural period P jaise hain, is liye resonance se un ka amplitude barhta jata hai. C aur D ki natural frequency P se mukhtalif hai, is liye woh taqreeban ruke rehte hain. Agar P ki lambai ℓ₂ kar di jaye to ab C aur D resonance se jhoolne lagte hain aur A aur B ruke rehte hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Zalzale (earthquake) ki seismic lehrein imaraton ko upar neeche aur aage peeche hilati hain; zalzale mein imaratein jhoolti hain. 8 October 2005 ko Azad Jammu aur Kashmir mein 7.6 magnitude (Richter scale) ka zalzala aaya jis ka markaz Muzaffarabad ke qareeb tha. Is mein 86 000 se zyada log jaan bahaq hue.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne zalzale ki shiddat '7.6 on reactor scale' chhapi hai. 'Reactor scale' naam ka koi paimana nahi; zalzale ki shiddat (magnitude) Richter scale (ya moment-magnitude scale) par napi jati hai. Sahi 'Richter scale par 7.6' hai.
Jahan resonance faidemand (useful) hai
1. Microwave oven mein khana garam karna

Microwave oven electromagnetic microwaves banata hai (gharelu ovens mein taqreeban 2.45 GHz, wavelength taqreeban 12 cm) aur unhen poore oven mein phaila deta hai. Microwaves khane ke pani ke molecules ko usi frequency par jhulati hain, aur molecules aapas mein takrate hain. Takrao se paida hone wali ragar pani ki kinetic energy ko garmi (heat) mein badal deti hai, jo khane ko garam karti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab microwave oven ki lehron ko 'super high frequency (3 GHz-30 GHz)' aur wavelength taqreeban 12 cm batati hai. Yeh dono aapas mein nahi milte: 12 cm wavelength ki frequency f = c/λ = (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(0.12 m) = 2.5 × 10⁹ Hz hai, jo 3 GHz se kam hai. Gharelu microwave ovens taqreeban 2.45 GHz (wavelength 12.2 cm) par chalte hain.
Jis khane mein pani ke molecules hon wahi microwave oven mein garam hota hai (Fig. 14.18). Plastic ya glass ke bartan garam nahi hote kyun ke un mein pani ke molecules nahi hote.
2. Radio tuning

Analogue radio par koi station lagana bhi resonance par mabni hai: hum radio ka knob ghumate hain. Asal mein is se receiver ke electrical circuit ki natural frequency badalti hai. Jab yeh station ki transmission frequency ke barabar ho jaye to resonance hoti hai, us station se sab se zyada energy jazb (absorb) hoti hai, aur hum sirf wahi station sunte hain. Simple radio Fig. 14.19 mein hai.
Ab kuch halaat jahan resonance se bachna chahiye:
1. Pul (bridge) ka thartharana

Fauji (soldiers) pul paar karte waqt qadam mila kar nahi chalte. Agar woh qadam mila kar chalein to ho sakta hai ke qadmon ki frequency pul ki natural frequency ke barabar ho jaye; resonance se pul bohat bare amplitude se jhoolne lagay aur gir bhi sakta hai.
2. Hawai jahaz (aeroplane) ka par (wing)

Tawazun (equilibrium) ke liye hawai jahaz do paron (wings) ke saath banaya jata hai. Paron par aerodynamic force, turbulence (hawa ke jhatke) aur engine ki thartharahat jaisi forces lagti hain. Agar in forces ki frequency paron ki natural frequency se mil jaye to resonance hogi, jo khatarnak sabit ho sakti hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text:
Jis frequency par koi cheez khud jhoolti hai use kitab resonance frequency kehti hai (yahi natural frequency hai, aur isi par resonance hoti hai).
Piano, violin aur guitar ka sound board taar ki thartharahat ke saath resonate karta hai: taar ki vibrations apni energy saaz ke khokhle lakri ke dabbe (sound box) ko deti hain, dabba resonate kar ke awaz ko unchi aur bharpoor bana deta hai.
Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) mein taqatwar radio-frequency lehrein nuclei ko jhulati hain aur nuclei energy jazb karte hain; jazb hui energy ke naqshe se computer jism ki andar ki tasveer banata hai.
Jhoole ko us ki natural frequency par baar baar dhakka dein to us ka amplitude barhta jata hai: dhakkon ki frequency jhoole ki natural frequency se milti hai.

blocks.prompt: Fauji pul paar karte waqt qadam mila kar kyun nahi chalte?
blocks.explanation: Qadam mila kar chalna pul par ek periodic force lagata hai. Agar is ki frequency pul ki natural frequency se mil jaye to resonance se pul ka amplitude khatarnak had tak barh sakta hai aur pul gir sakta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Resonance: driving frequency = natural frequency, to amplitude bohat bara.
Faidemand: microwave oven, radio tuning, saazon ke sound boards, MRI, jhoole ko dhakka.
Nuqsandeh: pul par qadam mila kar chalna, jahaz ke paron par forces, zalzale mein imaratein.
